Seconded: Cr. T. Nguyen

**Library Programs Committee – Meeting Agenda**
**Meeting #14/2024**
**Date:** Monday 18 March 2024
**Time:** 6:00 pm – 8:00 pm
**Location:** Penshurst Branch, Meeting Room 2 (ground floor)
**Chair:** M. Ricci
**Attendees (expected):** M. Ricci (Chair), P. Singh (Deputy Chair), R. Adams (Treasurer), C. Nguyen, J. Kowalski, A. Fernandez, T. Okafor, S. Petrov (apologies), L. Tran (apologies)
**Minutes of previous meeting:** Tabled 12 Feb 2024, Item 1.

---

**Item 1: Minutes of Previous Meeting (12 February 2024)**
- Minutes circulated via email on 26 February 2024.
- **Correction:** Item 4 of previous minutes – the action for R. Adams re: facilities check was incorrectly recorded as "by 30 October" – should read "by 30 October 2023" (already completed). No further corrections.
- **Moved:** C. Nguyen / **Seconded:** J. Kowalski – Minutes accepted as corrected. Carried.

---

**Item 2: Reports**

**2.1 Chair's Report (M. Ricci)**
- Attendance at the Council budget briefing on 5 March – no changes to programs allocation for 2024/25.
- Received positive feedback from the Family Storytime pilot at Oatley West (see Item 4 for expansion).
- Note: the new "Books on Prescription" shelving at the Penshurst branch is now complete; signage to be installed by end of March.

**2.2 Treasurer's Report (R. Adams)**
- Balance as at 29 February 2024: $18,240.50 (includes $4,500 programs contingency, unspent).
- Expenditure since last meeting: $320 for craft supplies (Kids Club), $85 for volunteer thank-you afternoon tea.
- **Action:** R. Adams to provide a detailed breakdown of the heritage week allocation (Item 5) for the next meeting.

**2.3 Programs Officer's Report (C. Nguyen)**
- Total programs delivered Feb 2024: 42 (target 40). Attendance: 1,150 (up 8% on Feb 2023).
- Top attendances: School holiday Lego Club (85), Author Talk with local writer (62), Tech Help drop-in (45).
- **Note:** The "Book a Librarian" one-on-one sessions have been moved to a booking-only system from 1 April – see Item 7.

---

**Item 3: Book Club Kit Service Expansion (P. Singh)**
- **Background:** Current book club kit collection – 24 titles, each with 10 copies. Circulation stats (2023): 82% utilisation rate; waiting lists for 6 popular titles.
- **Proposal:** Expand collection to 36 titles over the next 12 months. Focus on: Australian fiction (8 new), contemporary non-fiction (4 new), and a new "Read-Along" kit format for adults with low literacy (2 kits to trial).
- **Budget:** $1,800 for new kits (approx. $50 per kit for processing). Funding from programs contingency (Item 2.2).
- **Discussion:**
  - J. Kowalski asked about storage – current shelving at Penshurst is full. C. Nguyen confirmed Oatley West has a spare cupboard that could house 10–12 kits.
  - A. Fernandez queried the loan period. P. Singh suggested keeping the current 6-week loan period for books, but the new Read-Along kits would be 4 weeks (due to the CD/audio component).
- **Decision:** Committee agreed to proceed with the expansion, pending a detailed list of titles from P. Singh.
- **Action:** P. Singh to circulate the proposed title list and budget breakdown by 25 March.
- **Action:** C. Nguyen to confirm storage at Oatley West and report back at the next meeting.

**Library Programs Committee – Meeting Agenda**
**Meeting 7 of 2024**
**Date:** Monday 20 May 2024
**Time:** 6:00 pm – 8:00 pm
**Location:** Penshurst Library, Meeting Room 1 (via Zoom link for remote attendees – see attachment A)

**Attendees (expected):**
- A. Fernandez (Chair)
- P. Singh (Secretary)
- C. Nguyen (Programs Officer)
- R. Adams (Treasurer)
- J. Kowalski (Volunteer Coordinator)
- M. Okafor (Community Engagement)
- L. Tran (Branch Liaison, Oatley West)
- S. Petrov (New member – welcomed)

**Apologies:** T. Whitfield, D. Ioannou

---

**Item 1: Minutes of Previous Meeting (6 May 2024)**
- Minutes circulated via email on 13 May. 
- **Correction:** Item 5 of the previous minutes – the spelling of "heritage" in the program title was noted as "hertiage" in the original draft. Corrected version attached (Attachment B).
- **Motion:** That the minutes of the meeting held 6 May 2024 be confirmed as a true and accurate record, subject to the correction noted above.
- **Moved:** J. Kowalski. **Seconded:** M. Okafor. **Carried.**

---

**Item 2: Reports**

**2.1 Chair's Report (A. Fernandez)**
- Acknowledged the successful completion of the Autumn school holiday program. Total attendance across all sessions: 410 (target 350). 
- Noted the positive feedback from the "Author Talk" series – average satisfaction rating 4.6/5 (n=38 responses).
- **Action:** A. Fernandez to draft a thank-you letter to the local businesses that donated prizes for the holiday reading challenge. Due: 27 May.

**2.2 Treasurer's Report (R. Adams)**
- Balance as at 30 April 2024: $17,940.20 (includes $4,500 programs contingency, unspent).
- Expenditure since last meeting: $300.30 for new book club kit processing (Item 3 of previous meeting), $45.00 for printing of promotional flyers for the Digital Literacy series.
- **Note:** The $85 for volunteer thank-you afternoon tea (reported last meeting) was processed in the March statement, not April – this is a correction to the previous report.
- **Action:** R. Adams to provide a detailed breakdown of the heritage week allocation (Item 5 of previous meeting) for the next meeting. This is still outstanding.

**2.3 Programs Officer's Report (C. Nguyen)**
- Total programs delivered April 2024: 38 (target 40). Attendance: 1,020 (down 5% on April 2023, attributed to the school holiday period falling in a different week this year).
- Top attendances: School holiday Lego Club (78), Tech Help drop-in (52), Author Talk with local historian (48).
- **Update on "Book a Librarian":** The booking-only system commenced 1 April as planned. First month stats: 22 sessions booked, 3 no-shows. No issues with the online booking form.
- **New program proposal – Digital Literacy Workshop Series:** C. Nguyen presented a draft outline for a 6-week series aimed at seniors and new migrants. Topics include: using a smartphone, online safety, video calling, government services online, email basics, and an intro to AI tools. Proposed start date: July 2024. Budget estimate: $600 (includes $200 for an external facilitator for the AI session, $150 for printed guides, $250 for refreshments). 
- **Discussion:** 
  - J. Kowalski asked about promotion – C. Nguyen suggested using the library's social media and a targeted flyer drop at the local seniors' centre and the Migrant Resource Centre.
  - M. Okafor queried the timing – 10:00 am – 11:30 am on Tuesdays was suggested as the best slot based on feedback from similar programs at other branches.
  - S. Petrov asked about accessibility – C. Nguyen confirmed the room is wheelchair accessible and the library has a hearing loop.
- **Decision:** Committee agreed in principle to proceed with the Digital Literacy series. Formal approval of the budget to be sought at the next meeting.
- **Action:** C. Nguyen to circulate the full session-by-session outline and budget breakdown by 3 June.
